how_to_edit: Rooms, training and furnishings for the Hearth. Every number here can be tuned freely.
Rooms: the Hearth starts with starting_rooms. Each establishment tier (data/hearth_campaign.json tiers 'capacity') sets how many rooms can fit; build the rest with gold.
room_build_cost: the next room costs base + per_room x rooms already built.

qualities: from humblest to finest. slots = how many furnishings fit. training_bonus = extra % chance on every training session for whoever sleeps there. upgrade_cost = gold to raise a room to this quality. min_tier = establishment tier needed (0 = Roadside Hearth).

training: one session per adventurer per day. cost = base_cost + cost_per_point_above_10 x (stat - 10). chance starts at base_chance and falls by chance_drop_per_point_above_10 for each point above 10. A failed session adds a practice point; each practice point adds practice_bonus to that stat's next attempt and they reset on success. stat_cap is the highest a stat can be trained to.
learning_bonus: extra % chance by an adventurer's learning pace (shown after a tavern contest).

furnishings: id = lowercase_with_underscores. stats = extra % training chance for those attributes when placed in the trainee's room. suits = classes it is themed for (shown to the player). min_quality = the room quality needed to fit it.
Future idea: furnishings can grant other room bonuses (recovery, morale, starting items). Add new fields here and read them in scripts/game/hearth_lodging.gd.

qualities.name: Straw Cot
qualities.description: A straw mattress, a hook for a cloak, and a shutter that rattles.

qualities.name: Snug Bunk
qualities.description: A proper frame bed, a wool blanket and a chest at its foot.

qualities.name: Hearth Chamber
qualities.description: Warm floorboards, a writing desk and a window over the yard.

qualities.name: Lantern Suite
qualities.description: A canopy bed, a private hearth and room to practise in.

training_dummy.name: Training Dummy
training_dummy.description: Straw, sackcloth and a painted grin that has seen a thousand swings.

iron_dumbbells.name: Iron Dumbbells
iron_dumbbells.description: Two lumps of pig iron on a bar, polished by calloused hands.

weapon_rack.name: Weapon Rack
weapon_rack.description: Practice blades, staves and a shield with more dents than paint.

armor_stand.name: Armour Stand
armor_stand.description: A full harness to wear around the room until it feels like skin.

archery_target.name: Archery Target
archery_target.description: A straw butt pinned with feathers, hung where the window light falls.

lockpick_board.name: Lockpick Board
lockpick_board.description: A plank studded with old locks, each one a puzzle with a click at the end.

crystal_ball.name: Crystal Ball
crystal_ball.description: Cloudy glass that clears, now and then, for anyone patient enough to look.

spellbook_stack.name: Stack of Spellbooks
spellbook_stack.description: Borrowed, annotated and never quite returned to the Hearth library.

prayer_altar.name: Prayer Altar
prayer_altar.description: A small shrine with a candle that the keeper quietly keeps lit.

herb_garden.name: Window Herb Garden
herb_garden.description: Thyme, yarrow and feverfew in clay pots along the sill.

bonded_perch.name: Beast Perch
bonded_perch.description: A perch, a basket and a water bowl for whatever follows them home.

tall_mirror.name: Tall Mirror
tall_mirror.description: For rehearsing speeches, oaths and the occasional dramatic entrance.

lute.name: Well-loved Lute
lute.description: Three good strings and one that is mostly enthusiasm.

war_table.name: War Table
war_table.description: Maps of the Briarway weighted down with tankards and carved markers.

hearthstone_brazier.name: Hearthstone Brazier
hearthstone_brazier.description: Coals that hold the Hearth's warmth through the longest night.

starglass_orrery.name: Starglass Orrery
starglass_orrery.description: Brass rings that turn with the heavens and hum when a spell is near.
